test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Kanaka Raju was awarded Padma Shri in 2021 for contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is **Gussadi.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian gussadi dancer Kanaka Raju **performs. He received the Padma Shri honour from the Indian government in 2021 for his contributions to the arts.
 
• Gussadi Kanaka Raju, a tribal folk musician who received the **Padma Shri last year**, has a new job. He has been named the chief dance master (CDM) of the newly established **Kanaka Raju School of Gussadi Dance in Adilabad. **
 
• **Kanaka Raju received a Rs 1 crore gift **from chief minister K Chandrasekhar Rao, who also urged Asifabad MLA Athram Sakku to get involved in building the **tribal dancer's home.**
 
• **Ancient tribal dances **from the Australian outback include the** gussadi. **For a fortnight during the event, Dandari troupes perform it. Despite the religious and cultural matter's great **significance, successive administrations** did not acknowledge it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A traditional dance from Bengal's **Rarh area is called chhau.** It might have sprung from the Sanskrit word chya. Some believe it to be derived from the Odia word Chhauni, which means** "military camp, armour, and stealth."**
 
• A significant form of Indian classical dance is called **Sattriya or Sattriya Nritya.** In order to effectively disseminate the Vaishnava religion, the great Assamese reformer and Vaishnava saint Mahapurusha Sankaradeva created the Sattriya dancing style in the **15th century A.D.**
 
• The Maratha kings of South India, who dubbed this particular dance **Sadir Nautch, **are credited with coining the term Sadir.
